summary: Frontend e2e verified for new 'preferred contact channel' feature in PlannerForm and ContactForm on /planifica-tu-viaje, plus 'Canal pref.' column in admin leads tables. All 5 acceptance criteria pass functionally. One minor i18n bug in ContactForm inline error (literal key instead of translated string).

ui_bugs.issue: Inline preference error shows literal i18n key 'form_required' instead of translated text 'Campo obligatorio'. Root cause: in ContactForm.jsx:40, t('form_required') returns the key string (truthy) when the translation is missing, so the fallback `|| 'Campo obligatorio'` never activates. The key 'form_required' is not defined in any locale (es/en/fr).

action_items: Fix ContactForm.jsx line 40: either add 'form_required' translation to locale files (es: 'Campo obligatorio', en: 'Required field', fr: 'Champ obligatoire') OR change to `setPrefError(t('form_required', 'Campo obligatorio'))` or use a check like `const txt = t('form_required'); setPrefError(txt === 'form_required' ? 'Campo obligatorio' : txt);`. PlannerForm correctly uses an inline T() helper and shows 'Campo obligatorio' as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactForm uses i18n key 'form_required' that isn't defined anywhere — the fallback chain `t(key) || fallback` doesn't work when t() returns the key on missing translation (common react-i18next behavior). Add the key to locales or use a sentinel check.
PlannerForm and ContactForm use different validation/error-text strategies (T() helper vs t() lookup). Consider unifying for consistency.
seed_data_creation: Submitted 2 test leads via the live forms: (1) PlannerForm lead 'TEST Validator' / test_validator@example.com with preferred_contact=phone; (2) ContactForm lead 'TEST QuickValidator' / test_quick_validator@example.com with preferred_contact=email. Both visible in admin leads tables with correct '📞 Teléfono' and '✉️ Email' values in the 'Canal pref.' column.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All five acceptance criteria verified end-to-end against external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. PlannerForm is single-page (not multi-step nav) — Step 06 'Tus datos' is the last block on /planifica-tu-viaje and contains full-name/email/phone/notes plus the new planner-pref-phone/email radios, planner-what-next info block, and plan-trip-submit. ContactForm sits in the 'form-tab-quick' tab. Admin leads sub-tabs use testids admin-leads-tab-contact-requests and admin-leads-tab-trip-planner. The minor i18n bug does not block functionality — validation still prevents submission and the toast in Spanish appears.
rca_of_the_issue: ContactForm bug RCA: setPrefError(t('form_required') || 'Campo obligatorio') — react-i18next's t() returns the key itself (a truthy string) when the translation is missing, so the OR-fallback never executes. Fix: define the translation key in locale resources, or call t('form_required', { defaultValue: 'Campo obligatorio' }), or use the explicit second-arg signature t('form_required', 'Campo obligatorio') if supported.
